args.message: I added up order amounts for each region and city, then took a simple average across the cities in each region, so every city counts once. A city name that shows up in two regions counts separately in each: Oslo appears in both North and South. The no-region group (null) holds two city groups. One is Paris, with $677.83 of revenue. The other is $515.47 from 6 orders whose customer doesn't exist in the customer table, so it has no city either; I treated that as a city of its own. If you leave that group out, the no-region average is $677.83 instead of $596.65.
